title: Scan the book barcode
description: Point your camera at the ISBN barcode. If this edition already exists in the catalog, its saved information will fill the form automatically.
upload_instruction: A clear, uncropped barcode image works best.
instruction: Keep the barcode inside the frame and hold the book steady.
secure_context: Camera access requires HTTPS or localhost.
invalid_isbn: A barcode was detected, but it is not a valid 978 or 979 book ISBN. Try the ISBN barcode again.
camera_denied: Camera permission was denied. Allow camera access in your browser, then try again.
camera_unavailable: No available camera was found on this device.
camera_error: The camera could not be started. Close other camera apps and try again.
image_error: No valid ISBN barcode could be read from this image. Upload a clearer image and try again.
image_ocr_error: Neither an ISBN barcode nor a valid printed ISBN could be read. Enter the ISBN manually below.
match_found_description: The saved information for “{{title}}” was imported. Review every field before adding the book.
no_match: This ISBN is not saved yet
no_match_description: The ISBN was added to the form. Complete the remaining information manually.
lookup_error: The catalog search could not be completed
manual_title: Cannot scan it? Enter the ISBN
manual_description: Type the 13 digits printed below the barcode. A valid ISBN is detected automatically.
manual_invalid: Enter a valid 13-digit ISBN beginning with 978 or 979.
